title: Aliz Tutor lesson
description: One deterministic lesson for Aliz Tutor Mode: a 5-minute session, a short starter, or a one-step menu (kind choose). The LessonEngine owns pass/fail, progression, routing and rewards from this data alone; an LLM may only rephrase wording later and never changes expectedAnswers, stars or order. All keys are camelCase. Text is English, ASCII-printable, and short enough to be spoken as one TutorTurn (speech <= 160 chars, question <= 120 chars). Rules that depend on the step kind live in x-requiredByKind and x-forbiddenByKind so the validator and this file cannot drift.

lessonId.description: Must equal the file name without .json and appear in exactly one subject's lessonIds.

subjectId.description: A subjectId from subjects.json, or 'menu' for the entry (choose) lesson.

targetDurationSeconds.description: 300 for a full session. The validator's estimate (6 s per teach, 12 s per ask plus a 10 s retry allowance, 10 s per celebrate) must land within 20% of this.

helperLanguageKeys.description: Localization.key_for(<English line>) keys the helper-language (Thai by default) second line may translate. Each key must derive from a line that this lesson actually speaks.

steps.description: A menu lesson is a single choose step. Otherwise the first step is a teach (the greeting), the last step is the single celebrate, and at least one ask or sound step sits between them.

kind.description: teach: Aliz speaks. ask: a question with expectedAnswers. sound: like ask but expects an onomatopoeia and carries a reaction. celebrate: the closing step, stars and sticker. choose: Aliz asks what to learn; choices route to another lesson (lessonAction switch_lesson).

teachText.description: What Aliz says on a teach or celebrate step.

questionText.description: The question Aliz asks on an ask step.

visualAssetId.description: Flashcard shown for the step. Must be listed in res://content/tutor/assets_allowlist.json. Optional on teach/celebrate; every ask step in a full lesson carries one.

expectedAnswers.description: Lower-case English answers. The FIRST entry is the canonical answer Aliz teaches on the third attempt; the rest are synonyms and phrase forms ("an apple", "it's an apple"). No transliterations.

objective.description: What the child practises; shown to grown-ups, never scored.

hint.description: Spoken on the second unclear/incorrect attempt (give_hint).

encouragement.description: Spoken on the first unclear/incorrect attempt (retry). Kind, short, never says wrong.

successLine.description: Spoken when the answer matches. On a sound step it echoes the sound: 'Meow! You're amazing!'

answerLine.description: Optional. Spoken on the third attempt instead of the generated "It's <answer>! Say <answer>."

spokenLineId.description: Optional owner voice-pack line id (for example aliz_006_good_job). When absent the synthesis provider falls back to TTS.

itemId.description: Groups the steps about one thing (cat, dog, apple). handle_interjection() jumps to the first step of the item a barge-in names.

itemLabel.description: Spoken name of the item ('the dog'). Defaults to itemId with spaces.

choices.description: choose steps only: the lessons a child can pick, matched by the subject's keywords plus any extra answers.

defaultLessonId.description: choose steps only: where 'anything', 'you choose', 'I don't know' and a third unclear attempt go.

defaultLine.description: choose steps only: spoken when routing to defaultLessonId.

stars.description: Awarded once per lesson by LessonEngine when the last step is passed. 0 only for a menu lesson. Never reduced, never withheld.

reaction.description: How Aliz reacts to a correct sound (or ask) answer: a TutorFace gesture, a bundled sfx id, and the sound she makes back.

choice.description: One route out of a choose step. lessonId or subjectId (whose first lessonId is used); answers are merged with the subject's keywords from subjects.json.

line.description: Spoken when this choice is picked. Defaults to 'Okay! Let's learn about <subject title>!'
